name: code-diff-viewer
title: Code Diff Viewer
description: A line-by-line syntax diff viewer formatting added and deleted lines with green and red gutter tags.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Line Diff Inspection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
